classification.difficultyReason: Identify the ratio parts represented by a perimeter, one side or the difference between sides before finding all three lengths.

content.prompt:
The lengths of the sides of a triangle are in the ratio $3:4:5$.
Find the length of each side of the triangle if:

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}3+4+5&=12\text{ parts}\\12\text{ parts}&=192\text{ cm}\\1\text{ part}&=192\div12=16\text{ cm}\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times16=48\text{ cm}\\4\text{ parts}&=4\times16=64\text{ cm}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times16=80\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}3\text{ parts}&=9\text{ cm}\\1\text{ part}&=9\div3=3\text{ cm}\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times3=9\text{ cm}\\4\text{ parts}&=4\times3=12\text{ cm}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times3=15\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}5\text{ parts}&=9\text{ cm}\\1\text{ part}&=9\div5=1.8\text{ cm}\\3\text{ parts}&=3\times1.8=5.4\text{ cm}\\4\text{ parts}&=4\times1.8=7.2\text{ cm}\\5\text{ parts}&=5\times1.8=9\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
